Procedure title: Invitation to tender the provision of Photography and Videography Services for An Bord Bia.
Description: An Bord Bia seeks to appoint a suitably qualified supplier for the provision of photography and videography services for events, campaigns and communications activity of varying scale and complexity. Services may be required for, but are not limited to, consumer campaigns, media and PR activity, trade and industry events, producer and grower events, awards ceremonies, launches, stakeholder briefings, ministerial or senior representative engagements, sponsorship activations, social media content capture and other planned or ad hoc requirements nationwide across Ireland. Services will be required on an ad hoc basis throughout the year, including short-notice and unplanned requests.
